mods.name: NoHarvestAnimations
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Disables the first-person carcass harvesting and quartering animations, using the game's native progress circle instead. Optionally speeds harvesting and quartering up in real time, leaving the in-game time they cost unchanged.

mods.name: WolfHowlFix
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Fixes the broken "give up the chase" timer that makes wolf howls stutter and restart endlessly, most noticeable on aurora nights. Bears and cougars share the same defect and are fixed too. No animal tuning is changed.

mods.name: FreeLook
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Finally look around freely while walking! Keep an eye on predators or just take in the beautiful scenery.

status.patchnotes: Recall: tap X to swing back to whatever you were last looking at. Plus fixes for object placement and wolf struggles.

mods.name: SilentWalker
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Pack your gear like a seasoned survivor: bottles full and upright, metal separated and wrapped, firewood tied down. Makes your movement quieter for you, the wildlife, or both, with separate sliders for small supplies, wood, metal and water.

status.patchnotes: COMPLETE OVERHAUL! Now with two modes - Linked: One slider makes your footsteps quieter, for you AND for wildlife - Separate: Tune how much is just what you hear versus what the wildlife hears. Plus pack noise sliders for small supplies, wood, metal and water, detailed ground, clothing and tone controls, and an Enabled switch. Your 1.0.0 settings carry over.

mods.name: ObjectSinkFix
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Fixes furniture sinking into floors and the ground, and containers vanishing when you return to a location. Puts sunken furniture back and brings lost containers back, on existing saves. Works automatically.

status.patchnotes: First release. Stops furniture sinking, restores furniture that already sank, stops containers vanishing on reload, and brings back containers the bug already removed. One optional setting with ModSettings.
status.notes: ModSettings is optional and only needed for the one setting.

mods.name: DuplicateItemFix
mods.author: Lycanthor
mods.description: Repairs corrupt world-item data in an existing save. On a long-running save, sticks, stones, coal, bark tinder and crow feathers can pile up invisibly at one spawn point, so an item can be picked up more than once and returns to a spot you already cleared. This removes the extra entries as each region loads, and also collapses loose items that the world's gear list records more than once. Works automatically, with no settings.

status.patchnotes: First release. Repairs duplicated spawn-point entries and duplicated loose-item records in existing saves as each region loads. Back up your saves first. If a mod places the same item at identical coordinates twice, one copy is removed.
status.notes: Repairs existing damage only; it does not stop the damage from forming. Regions you never revisit keep their damage.
